title: Spidermanders
hook: Player-safe note: Spider-salamander hybrids coat themselves in pale ash, gripping stone with too many soft feet and leaving damp prints where the ground should be dry.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Give one concrete visual, one sound or texture, and one sign of who has used or neglected it.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: Spider-salamander hybrids coat themselves in pale ash, gripping stone with too many soft feet and leaving damp prints where the ground should be dry.; show instinct first through distance, posture, scent, and how the creature protects...

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Being surrounded, misread as a monster, or driven toward Root's Hollow, The Ash Quarry, Underroot by noise and haste.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
